inc-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: prod-east serving-runtime high OOM error rate on /v1/generate (sev=1). Observed 5xx spike, many pods crashlooping, autoscaler activity high. Paging @priya @chris oncall. See /incidents/1751239876 for context
priya: saw this come in ~2m ago. error rate ~48% on that route, latency tail spiking. probes show repeated CUDA OOM in gpushare pools.
chris: oncall here, grabbing. quick snapshot?
priya: past 10m logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z serving-runtime[pid=4721]: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.4 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity)
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z kubelet: Pod/serving-abc-2 restarted (OOMKilled)
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z autoscaler: scaleUp to 40 replicas -> scaling events every ~25s
2026-03-15T10:02:13Z serving-runtime[pid=4733]: Warning: model load failed: kernel reset on GPU
```
priya: looks like a feedback loop: many small scale-ups, pods start, fill GPU memory, crash -> autoscaler sees drop and scales up again (thrash).
jamal: joining. suspected cause: recent burst policy change last week reduced scaleDown stabilization to 20s. That plus aggressive scaleUp+binpacking into same nodes = memory contention.
diego: CS reports NovaChat saw 60% errors and message truncation. They called out model fallback behavior also not kicking in.
irene: tagging customer impact: NovaChat production -> partial outage starting 10:01 UTC. logs show repeated job restarts.
chris: immediate mitigations I'm going to try: 1) increase HPA scaleDown stabilization to 5m, 2) temporarily disable burst-scaling policy, 3) route /v1/generate to fallback smaller model (quantized) for prod-east region. anyone object?
priya: +1. also set maxScaleDown to limit concurrent evictions.
jamal: I'll run the patches. pulling up deploy-bot to do safe config changes.
deploy-bot: Command received: patch-autoscaler --target=serving-hpa-prod-east --set=behavior.scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds=300 --dry-run=false
jamal: running now:
```
kubectl patch hpa serving-hpa-prod-east -n redwood --type="merge" -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'
```
deploy-bot: Patch applied successfully. Current HPA behavior: scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds=300
chris: disabling burst policy (traffic-controller) for prod-east:
```
redwoodctl traffic policy set --region prod-east --burst-enabled false
```
deploy-bot: Traffic policy updated. Active burst pools reduced.
priya: routing rule change to fallback model (q4f16 small) ready. applying traffic split 80% fallback, 20% original while we stabilize.
jamal: applying split now.
deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: /v1/generate -> model:quant-small (80%), model:default (20%)
priya: monitoring. error rate dropping to ~12% now, latency tail improving. GPU OOM messages still appearing but much less frequent.
diego: notifying NovaChat CS: tentative mitigation in place, will provide timeline.
irene: sending note to NovaChat: "We’re routing production traffic to a reduced-memory model while we stabilize autoscaling. Investigating root cause and will follow up."
chris: next steps: 1) increase node diversity so autoscaler spreads pods across more nodes (reduce packing), 2) bump min replicas to keep warm nodes and avoid cold starts, 3) add KV cache pinning disabled for large requests. jamal can you work on node-affinity tweak?
jamal: will submit change: add podAntiAffinity + soft spread across GPU pools + bump minReplicas from 3->6 for prod-east serving deployment.
priya: also creating an eval to see if recent kernel driver update last week correlates; historical incidents low prior to 2026-03-08 driver bump.
chris: handoff: I'm keeping the channel open but leaving primary incident lead to priya/jamal. If we need pager escalation call @pager-duty.
priya: internal postmortem checklist started: doc link /incidents/postmortems/1751239876 (will fill).
diego: customer update sent at 10:30 UTC. NovaChat replied: thanks for quick response, impacted traffic normalized but want RCA.
jamal: change applied: added podAntiAffinity, minReplicas=6, will monitor for another 30m before re-enabling burst.
priya: after 14m stabilization: error rate ~2.4%, tail latency back to baseline. no further OOM crashes.
chris: marking incident as mitigated for now. keeping channel for RCA actions. please capture timeline and config diffs.
priya: notes to add to timeline: root cause suspected = autoscaler config (low stabilizationWindow) + aggressive burst policy + recent driver/packing increase. secondary = inability to failover to quantized model automatically.
jamal: follow-ups: 1) revert last week's driver roll to test in staging, 2) add autoscaler guard that prevents scale-up > X replicas / minute for GPU pools, 3) improve model fallback automation.
chris: thx everyone. closing paging loop. reactions: :thumbsup: :checkered_flag:
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to SEV-3 (mitigated). Incident channel will remain open for RCA edits until 2026-03-17."
